reason: On my $17k student budget, I have no reason to spend money when the core logging and RPG stats are free, especially when I can just invite five friends to get a month of Pro for free.
objection: How accurate is the calorie burn calculation for sports like padel, tennis, and swimming based on just my weight and height?
would_change_my_mind: If Pro included an actual visual RPG character avatar system that levels up and I ran out of friends to invite for free months.
